name: section-references
title: References Section
description: Past projects or clients as cards, in two layouts (grid, rows), that takes its colours, fonts and radius from the project's design system

layouts.title: Grid
layouts.description: One card per reference with its image, client, meta line, title and description, in one, two or three columns as the width grows; the default.

layouts.title: Rows
layouts.description: One reference per row in a card, the image beside the text from md, the image side alternating; without any image it draws the grid.
layouts.usage: <ReferencesSection layout="rows" content={{ title, items: [{ title, client, description, image, href }] }} />

proof: installs alone on Next 16; two layouts (grid, rows); rows without images draws the grid; 3 sample brands, light and dark, at 390/768/1280 px in two host apps; axe clean; no leak
postMessage: See components/section-references/README.md for the layouts, the design tokens it reads and the content props.
